messages:
emma: quick shoutout — zhen brought a giant thermos of homemade hot cocoa to the office this morning and organized an impromptu cookie swap. saved my day, thank you!! 
rajesh: yesss that cocoa = chef's kiss :heart_eyes: thanks zhen!
taylor: legend. left you a sticky note on the thermos so we remember whose Tupperware it is :)
zhen: haha glad you liked it! @luis helped with the cinnamon topping — team effort ❤️
luis: anytime. thinking of starting a small 'coffee & cocoa rota' so we don't run out. react with :raised_hands: if you wanna volunteer next week
ops-bot: poll created: "Coffee/Cocoa rota" — react to vote (1: I'm in / 2: Not this time). Poll ends in 48h
zhen: also huge thanks to @taylor for the extra spoons and to emma for wrangling cleanup :sparkles:
taylor: :wave: I'm in for the week of 5/6, will bring napkins
maya: can't make it but so grateful y'all do this — sending virtual cookie :cookie:
rajesh: left a note on the kitchen whiteboard: "please label containers" — tiny PSA to avoid future mysteries
emma: PSA accepted. labeled containers = saved lunches. pls label :)
zhen: plan for next swap: label containers, add nut-allergen tags, and a 'take only one unless cleared' sign. plus more cocoa options :cookie: :chocolate_bar:
luis: added to calendar: `Cocoa & Cookies — Fri 11am` (will send Teams invite)
taylor: on my way to buy napkins and disposable cups
emma: you all are the best. these tiny things make hybrid days feel cozy. :heart:
ops-bot: reaction summary — :raised_hands: 4, :thumbsup: 3, :heart: 5
